sentences.japanese: かわいそうな事にその老いた女性はまたもバッグを盗まれた。
sentences.english: The poor old woman had her bag stolen again.

sentences.japanese: 祖父は祖母がぽっくり逝ってから急に老け込みました。
sentences.english: After Grandma's sudden death, Grandpa began to age rapidly.

sentences.japanese: 老いも若きも戦争にいった。
sentences.english: Young and old went to battle.

sentences.japanese: 老いも若きも、また男女を問わず、地元の浴場で一緒になることを楽しみにしていた。
sentences.english: Both young and old, men and women, regularly get together at the local bathhouses.

sentences.japanese: 老いてくるにつれて自分自身の面倒を見られなくなる人は多い。
sentences.english: As they grow old, many people become unable to look after themselves.
